name: Physics
source: SAMPLE — replace with official WAEC syllabus content before production use
aims: To enable candidates develop an understanding of physical concepts and principles, the ability to apply them, and skills in scientific measurement, observation and experimentation.

subtopics.title: Fundamental and derived quantities
subtopics.content: Base SI quantities (length, mass, time, current, temperature, amount of substance, luminous intensity) and units; derived quantities and units.
objectives: State SI units of common physical quantities
Derive units of derived quantities from base units

subtopics.title: Measurement and errors
subtopics.content: Use of instruments (metre rule, vernier calliper, micrometer screw gauge); precision, accuracy and sources of error.
objectives: Read length measurements to appropriate precision

subtopics.title: Equations of uniformly accelerated motion
subtopics.content: Displacement, velocity, acceleration; the equations v = u + at, s = ut + ½at², v² = u² + 2as for motion in a straight line.
objectives: Apply the equations of motion to solve problems

subtopics.title: Newton's laws of motion
subtopics.content: The three laws of motion; inertia; momentum; force as rate of change of momentum; conservation of linear momentum.
objectives: State and explain Newton's three laws of motion
Apply F = ma to solve problems
Apply the principle of conservation of momentum to collisions

subtopics.title: Properties of waves
subtopics.content: Transverse and longitudinal waves; wavelength, frequency, period, amplitude, speed; the wave equation v = fλ.
objectives: Define wavelength, frequency, period and amplitude
Apply v = fλ to solve problems

subtopics.title: Electromagnetic induction
subtopics.content: Magnetic flux; Faraday's law and Lenz's law; e.m.f. induced when magnetic flux linked with a conductor changes; a.c. generator and transformer principle.
objectives: State Faraday's and Lenz's laws of electromagnetic induction
Explain how an e.m.f. is induced by changing magnetic flux
Describe the working principle of the a.c. generator and transformer
